description: This file defines the AnimateDrawable class, which extends ProxyDrawable and adds animation capabilities to a Drawable object. It manages an Animation instance, applies transformations during drawing, and provides methods to control and query animation state.

classes.name: AnimateDrawable
classes.description: An extension of ProxyDrawable that adds animation support, allowing a Drawable to be animated using an Animation object.

methods.name: AnimateDrawable
methods.description: Constructor initializing AnimateDrawable with a target Drawable, optionally with an Animation.

methods.name: getAnimation
methods.description: Returns the current Animation object associated with this drawable.

methods.name: setAnimation
methods.description: Sets the Animation object to be used for this drawable.

methods.name: hasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the animation has started.

methods.name: hasEnded
methods.description: Checks if the animation has ended.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Overrides the draw method to apply animation transformations before drawing the wrapped Drawable.
